checkout.venueNote: Pay at the club when you arrive. Your booking is confirmed by the club first.
checkout.legalPay: By paying you agree to the club's cancellation policy. Card details go straight to the payment provider.
checkout.legalBook: By booking you agree to the club's cancellation policy.

methods.label: Payment method

demo.note: No real money moves. Run the whole booking and payment journey.

split.title: Split the cost with friends
split.subtitle: Pay only your share. Friends get a link to pay theirs.
split.tooManyPlayers: That is too many players for this amount.
split.note: After you pay, share the link on WhatsApp or SMS. Your slot is held for {{minutes}} minutes. If your friends do not pay in time the links simply stop working: nothing is refunded automatically, your booking is not cancelled, and you can pay the remaining balance yourself from the payment progress page.

handoff.title: Send these links to your friends
handoff.note: Save these now. For security they are shown only once, though you can always issue a new link from the payment progress page.

retry.title: Try another card

success.title: Booking confirmed
